newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla shares fall after juice recalled.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla shares fall after juice recalled.

text.p: Odwalla Inc.'s stock tumbled Thursday after officials traced an outbreak of food poisoning to the company's juice products and the California-based company recalled some of its products.
Odwalla, based in Half Moon Bay, Calif., Wednesday issued a natiowide recall of products containing fresh apple juice, and many retailers pulled Odwalla beverages from their shelves.

The same day, Washington State and county health officials said that 10 of the 13 confirmed cases of bacterial food poisoning in the Seattle area had been traced to Odwalla juice. Three other cases remained under investigation, they said.
Odwalla stock was off $5.375 at $13 after falling as low as $11, a 52-week low, earlier in trading on Nasdaq.
Hambrecht & Quist downgraded the stock to hold from buy, saying publicity surrounding the recall could hurt sales.
